meta.title: Finishcoat demo: Juniper and Oak Bakery

set_permalink_structure( '/%postname%/' ); flush_rewrite_rules( false ); // Leave only the demo page in the menu. foreach ( array( 'sample-page' => 'page', 'hello-world' => 'post' ) as $slug => $type ) { $old = get_page_by_path( $slug, OBJECT, $type ); if ( $old ) { wp_delete_post( $old->ID, true ); } } $up = wp_upload_dir( null, false ); $img = $up['baseurl'] . '/finishcoat-demo/'; $content = '

Bread worth getting up early for

' . '

Naturally leavened loaves, laminated pastry and good coffee. Baked every morning on Alder Street.

' . '' . '

Small batches since 2019

' . '

We shape every loaf by hand, give the dough a slow overnight rise, and bake in small batches so the shelves turn over before noon.

' . '' . '

Try it: open the Suggestions tab on the right, press Pin it to a spot, then click anything on this page. Point at a picture and press Try my photo here.

'; $page_id = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_name' => 'bakery-demo', 'post_title' => 'Juniper and Oak Bakery', 'post_content' => $content, ) ); // Block themes that have a "Page No Title" template (Twenty Twenty-Four and Twenty Twenty-Five) skip the page title. update_post_meta( $page_id, '_wp_page_template', 'page-no-title' ); // Show the tab to every visitor. The logged-in Playground admin gets studio mode. $s = get_option( 'finishcoat_settings' ); $s = is_array( $s ) ? $s : array(); $s['show'] = 'everyone'; update_option( 'finishcoat_settings', $s ); if ( function_exists( 'finishcoat_codes' ) && function_exists( 'finishcoat_code_new' ) && function_exists( 'finishcoat_save_codes' ) ) { $codes = finishcoat_codes(); if ( count( $codes ) < 2 ) { $codes[] = finishcoat_code_new( $codes, 'Marketing lead' ); finishcoat_save_codes( $codes ); } } // Two sample notes in the plugin's own storage format, so the page has numbered pins on arrival. $path = (string) wp_parse_url( get_permalink( $page_id ), PHP_URL_PATH ); $origin = function_exists( 'finishcoat_site_origin' ) ? finishcoat_site_origin() : untrailingslashit( home_url() ); $note = function ( $body, $author, $role, $parent, $anchor, $status ) use ( $path, $origin ) { $id = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => 'finishcoat_note', 'post_status' => 'private', 'post_parent' => $parent, 'post_title' => mb_substr( $author . ': ' . $body, 0, 90 ), 'post_content' => $body, ) ); update_post_meta( $id, '_finishcoat_project', 'site' ); update_post_meta( $id, '_finishcoat_page', $path ); update_post_meta( $id, '_finishcoat_page_title', 'Juniper and Oak Bakery' ); update_post_meta( $id, '_finishcoat_author', $author ); update_post_meta( $id, '_finishcoat_role', $role ); update_post_meta( $id, '_finishcoat_origin', $origin ); if ( 'client' === $role ) { update_post_meta( $id, '_finishcoat_code_label', 'Owner' ); } if ( ! $parent ) { update_post_meta( $id, '_finishcoat_status', $status ); } if ( $anchor ) { update_post_meta( $id, '_finishcoat_anchor', wp_slash( wp_json_encode( $anchor ) ) ); } return $id; }; $first = $note( 'Can the big heading say what people ask us most? Something like "Fresh out of the oven at 7am".', 'Maya', 'client', 0, array( 'sel' => '#fc-hero', 'rx' => 0.95, 'ry' => 0.5, 'dx' => 0.5, 'dy' => 0.1, 'vw' => 1280, 'lbl' => 'Bread worth getting up early for' ), 'doing' ); $note( 'Good call. I will swap that in and keep the photo under it.', 'Sam', 'studio', $first, null, '' ); $note( 'We opened in 2018, not 2019. Small thing, but my mom will notice.', 'Maya', 'client', 0, array( 'sel' => '#fc-about', 'rx' => 0.95, 'ry' => 0.5, 'dx' => 0.5, 'dy' => 0.5, 'vw' => 1280, 'lbl' => 'Small batches since 2019' ), 'new' ); if ( function_exists( 'finishcoat_bust_waiting' ) ) { finishcoat_bust_waiting(); }
